description: This file defines the main React application component for a frontend project, including layout, routing, authentication state management, theme toggling, and UI controls. It imports various React components, hooks, and external libraries, and sets up guarded routes based on user authentication and admin status.

classes.name: SessionState
classes.description: Interface for representing user session state, including user ID and email.

classes.name: AppAuthState
classes.description: Interface extending SessionState with an isAdmin flag to represent authentication and authorization state.

classes.name: GuardedRouteProps
classes.description: Interface for the properties of GuardedRoute component, including route element and auth requirements.

methods.name: setAppAuthState
methods.description: Updates the shared app authentication state and notifies registered listeners.

methods.name: useIsAdmin
methods.description: Custom hook that provides the current isAdmin state, updating on changes.

methods.name: AuthGuard
methods.description: Component that wraps routes to enforce authentication and admin-only access, displaying loading or redirecting as necessary.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main component that manages layout, theme, navigation, user session, and routing for the application.

methods.name: resolveIsAdmin
methods.description: Asynchronous function to determine if the current user has admin privileges.

methods.name: handleSignOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user from the application.
